art_request.contract: One swarm entity and anchor;128x128 runtime display,48px circular contact envelope covering most living flies. Same radius for shots/contact/scenery. Death never contacts and does not loop.

proposed_health.encounter_stage: Early first-level traversal, initially shown alone before mixed fights
proposed_health.rationale: Nuisance rather than bullet sponge: two6-damage pressure bolts or one24-damage plunger. Existing30–40HP opening band is a guideline; lower health justified by obstacle role.
proposed_health.comparison: All hits land once at full damage; no armor/resistance; melee must reach airborne core.
proposed_health.registration: Canonical HP is bestiary/sewer-flies/monster.json#health; handoff retains design rationale only. Initial12HP authorized as implementation tuning under request; not separately user-selected.

proposed_contact.hero_damage_scale: Current contact-hit player HP scale; revisit with any HP migration.
proposed_contact.monster_damage_scale: Current enemy numeric HP scale; asymmetry intentional, not six hero damage.
proposed_contact.cooldown_scope: One sewer-fly damage cooldown on each target shared across all swarms, preventing stacked swarm hits. Leaving/re-entering overlap does not reset it.
proposed_contact.first_hit: Immediate valid overlap if target cooldown and invulnerability permit; then next at1.5s minimum.
proposed_contact.tick_rule: Use time, not frame count. No accumulated burst or catch-up ticks after pause/large delta.
proposed_contact.player_protection: Honor existing global hurt invulnerability and respawn/death/dialogue protections. Successful contact starts normal invulnerability; no stacked hazard hits.
proposed_contact.damage_dispatch: Use normal target damage/death pipeline; one swarm collision, not one hit per tiny bug.

damage: living ordinary monsters including Flushfiends and Hallowed Widows
proposed_target_filter.bosses: Contact may damage a boss only through its exposed damageable collider and normal vulnerability rules; never bypass shell or closed phase. One damage event per boss even across overlapping parts.
proposed_target_filter.credit: Monsters killed by swarm count as defeated for encounter gates, but not player weapon kills or player-kill achievements.
proposed_target_filter.notes: Same-swarm immunity and boss rules are proposed filters, not explicit user decisions.

proposed_movement.algorithm: Retain heading. At timed updates add bounded random angular offset, then steer smoothly with speed/turn/acceleration limits. Slow to hover and accelerate out; do not instantaneously reset velocity.
proposed_movement.inputs: Per-swarm seeded RNG, physics time, authored bounds and solid geometry only; no player/enemy position in steering.
proposed_movement.priority: Collision safety first, boundary/obstacle steering second, random wander third. Do not sum equal opposing forces and jitter in corners.
proposed_movement.bounds: Author simple connected flight regions, accounting for full collider radius. Steer before edge; swept collision is final protection. Keep spawn/region away from narrow mandatory paths.
proposed_movement.obstacles: Use current physical solids and partially opened doors. Avoid wall penetration; slide away or turn into valid clearance. One-way platforms can be crossed only when tagged explicitly for swarm flight.
proposed_movement.stuck_recovery: If intended movement makes less than4px progress over1s outside intentional hover, select a collision-free inward heading using bounded candidate checks; never teleport. If no route is free, hover harmlessly until geometry changes and retry at bounded intervals.
proposed_movement.overlap: No avoidance of heroes/monsters: contact is incidental. Other swarms may overlap, sharing target cooldown.
proposed_movement.safe_route: First introduction leaves a clear bypass and room to learn. Initial swarms optional and excluded from gate-clear requirements; their kills of existing gate enemies still count.
proposed_movement.animation: Select from actual velocity after collision. Use4px/s hover threshold and20% dominant-axis hysteresis; preserve loop clock across direction changes to avoid frame-zero flicker.
proposed_movement.determinism: Fixed physics updates; seeded RNG only at elapsed decision events, never per render frame. Separate seeds per spawn ID; cap catch-up after long stalls.
proposed_movement.tuning_status: Initial implementation defaults; validate visually and adjust before claiming feel is final.

proposed_spawn_lifecycle.placement: Authored bounded spawn regions with valid walk-around space; no endless random generation.
proposed_spawn_lifecycle.first_pass_limit: One swarm per intro region; maximum two per encounter for initial evaluation.
proposed_spawn_lifecycle.spawn: Pre-place off camera or activate entirely beyond viewport; no visible pop-in or spawning overlapping another actor.
proposed_spawn_lifecycle.despawn: Camera culling does not kill/reset actor. Suspend only when region truly unloaded; preserve HP, death and encounter state.
proposed_spawn_lifecycle.restart: Full restart restores placement, health and deterministic seed; checkpoint respawn preserves defeated swarms like other enemies.
proposed_spawn_lifecycle.death: Disable contact immediately at0HP, play finite disperse/fall animation and remove after completion. No lingering damaging particles or child enemy spawns.

proposed_weapon_interaction.collision: One damageable swarm core; shots, melee and explosions each hit it at most once per attack under weapon rules.
proposed_weapon_interaction.projectiles: Respect existing projectile collision/despawn, aim and range; no per-fly pierce multiplier.
proposed_weapon_interaction.knockback: Use existing weapon impulse, clamp displacement to flight bounds/solids, then resume random flight without aggro.
proposed_weapon_interaction.health_visuals: Standard health fractions apply but multiple thresholds may be skipped by low HP/high damage. Initial mockup only includes movement and death; six damage stages are not claimed delivered.

Confirm fly-on-monster damage, same-swarm immunity and boss vulnerability filtering.
Check two Tony hits/one Sean hit, unique hit accounting, instant harmless death.
Verify offscreen activation and checkpoint persistence without duplicated spawns.
Evaluate readable contact core, dodge routes and six animation states at gameplay size.
Run60s simulations across20 seeds for bounds/solids/stuck recovery, with render FPS30/60/120 and fixed physics tick.

Validate near-45-degree animation direction stability and preserved wingbeat phase.
Both-hero level runs include swarms; report deaths/difficulty rather than silently weakening unrelated enemies.
